in_marathi.name: Kartavya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kartavya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Kartavya’ which means 'that which should be done'. It is a name with strong spiritual connotations and is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology. In Hindu scriptures, it is used to refer to the moral duty of an individual towards society and towards God.
